title: FLIR1 / "Tic Tac" (Nimitz)
incidentLocation: Pacific Ocean, ~100 mi off San Diego, CA, USA
description: Verification score 24/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 5 · Custody 5 · Corroboration 5 · Tech 5 · Debunk-resist 4 · Proximity 5. Source: US Navy ATFLIR pod; DoD FOIA release. Pentagon-authenticated file. Corroborated by radar (USS Princeton), multiple pilots (Fravor, Dietrich), ship personnel. SCU published ~270-page independent study (2019). Skeptics propose IR/distance artifacts but radar+visual+IR record stands.

title: GIMBAL (USS Theodore Roosevelt)
incidentLocation: Atlantic Ocean, off the US East Coast (Florida/Jacksonville area)
description: Verification score 21/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 5 · Custody 5 · Corroboration 4 · Tech 4 · Debunk-resist 3 · Proximity 5. Source: US Navy ATFLIR pod; DoD FOIA release. Pentagon-authenticated. Embedded metadata, comm chatter ("whole fleet of them"). Mick West argues the rotation is an IR gimbal/glare artifact - contested. Strong provenance, debated interpretation.

title: GOFAST (USS Theodore Roosevelt)
incidentLocation: Atlantic Ocean, off the US East Coast (Florida/Jacksonville area)
description: Verification score 19/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 5 · Custody 5 · Corroboration 3 · Tech 4 · Debunk-resist 2 · Proximity 5. Source: US Navy ATFLIR pod; DoD FOIA release. Pentagon-authenticated file. Parallax analysis suggests object may be slow-moving, appearing fast due to camera geometry. Most-explained of the three. Record solid; "anomaly" weakest.

title: McMinnville (Trent) Photos
incidentLocation: McMinnville, Oregon, USA (Trent farm, Yamhill County)
description: Verification score 19/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 4 · Custody 3 · Corroboration 3 · Tech 5 · Debunk-resist 4 · Proximity 4. Source: Paul & Evelyn Trent; published in Life. Negatives analyzed by Condon Committee (Hartmann), Dr. Bruce Maccabee (Navy optical physicist), French analysts. Hartmann: consistent with genuine distant object. Hoax theories (suspended model) proposed but unproven. Among most-studied photos ever.

title: Lubbock Lights
description: Verification score 16/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 3 · Custody 3 · Corroboration 4 · Tech 3 · Debunk-resist 3 · Proximity 4. Source: Carl Hart Jr. (photos); TX Tech professors (witnesses). V-formation photographed by college student; witnessed by multiple Texas Tech professors. Project Blue Book never conclusively debunked photos. "Plover reflection" theory widely disputed.

title: Trindade Island Photos (Brazil)
description: Verification score 16/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 3 · Custody 3 · Corroboration 4 · Tech 3 · Debunk-resist 3 · Proximity 4. Source: Almiro Barauna; Brazilian Navy ship Almirante Saldanha. Four photos aboard a Brazilian Navy vessel with witnesses present. Navy vouched for authenticity. Skeptics allege darkroom fakery by photographer (known trick photographer) - genuinely contested.

title: Nash-Fortenberry Sighting
incidentLocation: Chesapeake Bay area, near Norfolk, Virginia, USA
description: Verification score 17/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 4 · Custody 3 · Corroboration 4 · Tech 2 · Debunk-resist 4 · Proximity 5. Source: Two Pan Am pilots over Chesapeake Bay. No imagery but exceptionally credible: two commercial pilots independently described 8 glowing discs maneuvering. Benchmark witness case. Included as high-credibility no-image reference.

title: Phoenix Lights
incidentLocation: Phoenix / Prescott area, Arizona, USA (also Sonora, Mexico)
description: Verification score 17/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 3 · Custody 3 · Corroboration 5 · Tech 3 · Debunk-resist 3 · Proximity 4. Source: Thousands of Arizona residents. Massive multi-witness event. Two phenomena: a V-formation (some footage) and later flares (USAF A-10 drop, largely accepted). Flare portion explained; earlier silent craft formation remains debated.

title: Belgian Wave / Petit-Rechain photo
description: Verification score 14/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 2 · Custody 2 · Corroboration 5 · Tech 3 · Debunk-resist 2 · Proximity 3. Source: Belgian public; Belgian Air Force F-16 radar. Wave of triangle sightings with Belgian AF radar locks and F-16 scrambles - strong official corroboration of SOMETHING. BUT famous Petit-Rechain triangle photo confessed as styrofoam hoax in 2011. Event strong, photo debunked.

title: Aguadilla / Puerto Rico (DHS/CBP)
incidentLocation: Off Aguadilla / Rafael Hernandez Airport, Puerto Rico
description: Verification score 18/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 4 · Custody 4 · Corroboration 3 · Tech 4 · Debunk-resist 3 · Proximity 4. Source: US Customs & Border Protection thermal camera. Thermal footage from CBP aircraft of object over land/water, appearing to split. SCU published analysis. Skeptics (Mick West) argue wedding/Chinese lantern - contested. Good provenance, debated.

title: USS Omaha "Spherical"
incidentLocation: Pacific Ocean, off San Diego, CA, USA
description: Verification score 19/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 4 · Custody 4 · Corroboration 4 · Tech 3 · Debunk-resist 4 · Proximity 5. Source: US Navy; leaked then confirmed by Pentagon/UAPTF. Night-vision footage of spherical object descending toward ocean off San Diego. Pentagon (UAPTF) confirmed genuine Navy imagery. Sphere among recurring "morphologies" AARO tracks.

title: Calvine Photo (Scotland)
description: Verification score 14/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 3 · Custody 2 · Corroboration 2 · Tech 3 · Debunk-resist 4 · Proximity 3. Source: Two witnesses; surfaced via UK MoD / 2022 release. Long-suppressed high-clarity photo of a diamond craft near a Harrier. One of 6 prints; resurfaced 2022 via researcher David Clarke + UK MoD files. Witnesses anonymous but image quality and MoD interest notable.

title: Chilean Navy "Helicopter" Video
incidentLocation: Off the coast near Santiago, Chile (Chilean coast)
description: Verification score 18/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 4 · Custody 4 · Corroboration 3 · Tech 4 · Debunk-resist 3 · Proximity 5. Source: Chilean Navy helicopter FLIR; released by CEFAA. Nine minutes of FLIR from a Chilean Navy chopper, officially investigated and released by Chile's CEFAA. Object expelled a plume. Skeptics suggest distant aircraft (IB6830) contrail - contested. Strong official provenance.

title: Skinny Bob videos
incidentLocation: Unknown / unverified (claimed USSR; no real location)
description: Verification score 6/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 1 · Custody 1 · Corroboration 1 · Tech 2 · Debunk-resist 1 · Proximity 1. Source: Anonymous YouTube "ivan0135"; no source ever given. Anonymous upload, uploader vanished. Film-grain/scratch overlay = modern stock effect; text font modern; opening KGB still lifted from 1998 doc "Secret KGB UFO Files." Zero provenance. Likely film/student project. Benchmark for LOW verifiability.

title: Nazca/Mexico "Biologics" (Maussan)
incidentLocation: Nazca / Palpa desert region, Peru (presented in Mexico City)
description: Verification score 9/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 2 · Custody 1 · Corroboration 2 · Tech 3 · Debunk-resist 1 · Proximity 2. Source: Jaime Maussan team; specimens from Peru. CT/X-ray scans exist & are decent quality, but READINGS cut AGAINST authenticity: 2021 paper found head is deteriorated llama braincase; Estrada (2024) called them animal-bone+glue dolls; independent X-ray experts say bones arranged non-biologically. Montserrat specimen (presented Apr 2024) claimed to hold a fetus (43mm femur, <30wks) - interpretation not independent confirmation; Peruvian Ministry of Culture tried to SEIZE it at the press conference, pointing to looted human remains. "Unknown DNA" unpublished/unreplicated. Maussan has prior debunked "alien body" presentations (2015 Roswell slides). Contested, leans hoax.

title: Buga Sphere (Colombia)
description: Verification score 11/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 2 · Custody 1 · Corroboration 2 · Tech 4 · Debunk-resist 2 · Proximity 2. Source: Recovered locally; passed to Maussan. Scan quality is genuinely decent: X-ray/tomography show 3 layers, internal microspheres, no welds/joints, microscopy to 2000x. BUT scans only confirm a manufactured object exists (undisputed) - cannot distinguish exotic from fabricated art. Seamless spheres are makeable (spin-form/electroform). Broken custody: multiple private hands (local -> treasure hunter -> Maussan) before controlled analysis; no peer review. Scientists (Mossbridge) urged validation via Galileo Project. Unverified.

title: Chris Bledsoe (experiencer)
description: Verification score 9/30 (ORANGE tier). Dimensions — Provenance 2 · Custody 2 · Corroboration 2 · Tech 1 · Debunk-resist 2 · Proximity 3. Source: Single experiencer; personal photos/video. Experiencer case, not imagery-verification. Claims orbs, healing, recurring entity. Has believers in defense/intel circles (sociologically notable). Imagery is uncontrolled light photos; no independent sensor data. Testimonial bucket; included for completeness.

title: Cmdr. David Fravor — Firsthand (pilot)
description: US Navy (Ret.); CO, Black Aces (VFA-41). Described the 2004 Nimitz "Tic Tac" encounter off California: a ~40ft object with no wings/exhaust that maneuvered instantly and outran his F/A-18. Said "the technology we faced was far superior to anything we had." Caveats: Strongest tier: firsthand sensory account, multi-witness, tied to Pentagon-authenticated FLIR1 video. Most-corroborated witness in the roster.

title: Ryan Graves — Firsthand (pilot)
description: US Navy (Ret.) F/A-18 pilot; Exec. Dir., Americans for Safe Aerospace. Testified his squadron saw UAPs off the Atlantic coast near Virginia Beach almost daily over ~8 years (2014+), describing "dark gray/black cubes inside a clear sphere." Stressed reporting stigma & flight-safety risk. Also relayed a secondhand Vandenberg 2003 account. Caveats: Strong: firsthand, repeated observations, sensor + visual. Distinguishes his own sightings from the secondhand Vandenberg report he relayed.

title: David Grusch — Secondhand / whistleblower
description: US Air Force (Ret.) Maj.; former NRO rep to UAP Task Force. Testified under oath that the US runs a multi-decade UAP crash-retrieval & reverse-engineering program, has recovered "non-human biologics," and that he faced "administrative terrorism" retaliation. Said his knowledge came via official duties from 40+ interviewees. Caveats: IMPORTANT: explicitly secondhand — he relayed what others told him, did not claim to have seen craft/bodies himself. Pentagon said it found no verifiable info to substantiate. High-profile but unverified; weight accordingly.

title: Luis Elizondo — Insider / program
description: Former DoD official; ex-head of AATIP. Stated plainly "UAP are real" and that advanced technologies "not made by our government, or any other government, are monitoring sensitive military installations." Testified to secret crash-retrieval programs under questioning. Caveats: Insider-program testimony, not a sensory eyewitness account. Central disclosure figure (ran AATIP). Claims about programs remain officially unconfirmed; testimonial weight, not physical evidence.

title: Rear Adm. Tim Gallaudet — Firsthand-adjacent / official
description: US Navy (Ret.) Rear Admiral; oceanographer. Testified an object "exhibiting flight and structural characteristics unlike anything in our arsenal" was observed during a 2015 East Coast naval exercise; described a Navy email about the GO FAST footage later disappearing from systems. Caveats: High credentials (flag officer, scientist). Account is of documented Navy material/exercise rather than his own cockpit sighting. Credible source; interpretation open.

title: Michael Gold — Policy / scientific
description: Former NASA Associate Administrator; NASA UAP Study Team. Spoke to NASA's UAP study, the stigma problem, and the need for rigorous scientific data collection; questioned on whether govt/contractors possess non-human tech (no firsthand knowledge claimed). Caveats: Not a witness to a sighting — a science/policy perspective. Useful for institutional context, not an evidentiary sighting account.

title: Michael Shellenberger — Journalist / documentary
description: Journalist; founder of Public. Submitted a 12-page report (sourced to a current/former official) alleging a secret program ("Immaculate Constellation") managing UAP/NHI issues outside congressional oversight. Caveats: Journalist relaying an anonymous source — not sworn firsthand military testimony. Lowest evidentiary weight in this tab; included for completeness of the hearing record.

title: Robert Salas — Firsthand (historical)
description: US Air Force (Ret.) Capt.; former Minuteman launch officer. Recounted the March 1967 Malmstrom AFB incident: a red-glowing object reported over the launch facility while ~10 Minuteman missiles went to no-go status. Has testified/affirmed this account for years (incl. 2001 Disclosure Project). Caveats: Firsthand for the security/shutdown timeline. Note: skeptics (incl. James Carlson) argue the documented Echo Flight shutdown had an engineering cause; the UFO causal link rests on testimony. Decades-old recall.

title: UFOs: Generals, Pilots, and Government Officials Go on the Record
description: By Leslie Kean. Sourced, on-the-record testimony from credentialed officials. A go-to for cited, named-witness cases.

title: The UFO Experience: A Scientific Inquiry
description: By J. Allen Hynek. Hynek (Project Blue Book scientific consultant) introduced the Close Encounter classification. Foundational, methodical.

title: Final Report of the Scientific Study of UFOs (Condon Report)
description: By Edward U. Condon / Univ. of Colorado. Skeptical overall but contains the Hartmann analysis of McMinnville. Primary source; rigorous photogrammetry.

title: Project Blue Book (declassified files)
description: By US Air Force. ~12,000 cases, ~700 unexplained. The core US government primary record. Available via National Archives.

title: Scientific Coalition for UAP Studies (SCU) reports
description: By SCU (various). Independent, methods-forward analyses (Nimitz, Aguadilla). Best for technical/physics treatment.

title: The Sturrock Panel Report
description: By Peter Sturrock et al.. Stanford physicist convened scientists to review physical-evidence cases. Argues for scientific study.

title: AARO Historical Record Report Vol. 1
description: By US DoD (AARO). The Pentagon's own review of US gov UAP involvement since 1945. Official baseline (skeptical conclusions).

title: Imminent
description: By Luis Elizondo. Former AATIP lead. Insider account; testimonial not evidentiary, but central to recent disclosure context.

title: UFOlogy: A Major Breakthrough in the Scientific Understanding of Unidentified Flying Objects
description: By James M. McCampbell. Aerospace engineer's systematic attempt to derive UFO characteristics - propulsion, electromagnetic interference, and physiological effects on witnesses - from the consistencies across reported sightings. An early scientific-method treatment of the phenomenon, referenced in the CIA's declassified UFO holdings.
